tests.title: parses positional and named decimal options and refuses expressions, suffixes, unknown options and out-of-range values with exact messages
declares stateless frame allocation, refuses rate conversion and FLAC timing, and leaves counts, packets and reservations unchanged
negotiates every input format to s32p and keeps native merges with volume and asetnsamples
matches the C transcription on every branch, threshold edge and clip, for every parameter pair, with frame-split invariance
converts integer and floating input to s32p first, owns its output and never mutates the input
enforces frame allocation limits and observes cancellation
matches native dcshift s32 raw, s32 WAV, s16 WAV and framecrc bytes for every shift and limiter gain on integer and float sources
matches native dcshift chains with volume and asetnsamples, named options, mono and three-channel input and output time selection
refuses out-of-range options, expressions, enable and unknown options before writing output, where native also fails or accepts unimplemented forms

nativeComparisons.compares: byte-exact s32le raw, s32 WAV, s16 WAV and framecrc: shift {0,0.3,-0.7,1,-1} x limitergain {0,0.4,1} x stereo u8/s16/s32 (with INT_MIN/INT_MAX and threshold-edge samples) and f32/f64 |x|<=1.1 sources (-cpuflags 0, float sources gated to linux x64)

byte-exact framecrc for 7 chains (volume=0.5 before/after, fixed volume after, asetnsamples=7 with and without padding, named options, two dcshifts) x mono/3-channel x 5 sources x 4 output selections (none, -ss/-t, -frames:a 3, -t 0.001) x pcm_s32le/pcm_s16le/pcm_f64le

native exit status for refusals: 6 that native also rejects (shift=2, limitergain=-1, -1.5:0.5, 0:1.5, three positional values, unknown option), 4 that native accepts but are refused unimplemented (two expressions, a fraction expression, enable), and fixed volume before dcshift on s16 (registry negotiation guard); no output written in each case

unsupported: FLAC input (refused before decoding; flacInput not declared)
option expressions, suffixes, nan and empty values
fixed volume before dcshift on u8/s16 input (registry negotiation guard refuses: 'dcshift with <fmt> input requires unimplemented format negotiation')
s64/s64p and other formats are not applicable: work format is always s32p

notes: No shared edit beyond the registry line was needed.

Baseline unit failures are the expected sandbox ones: FLAC tests missing .build/codecs/flac artifacts (downloads.xiph.org blocked) and 10 resample-checkpoint golden digests recorded on macOS arm64. Final unit failures are identical.

The divide-by-zero in native's negative limiter branch (shift=-1:limitergain=1 on INT32_MIN) gives -inf; x86-64 cvttsd2si converts it to INT64_MIN, clipped to INT32_MIN. The implementation makes that explicit and the s32 differential grid covers it.
Setup durations: submodule init 97 s, npm ci + reference:build 207 s, baseline static checks + unit suite 159 s.
